statement: Let U, D, L, R be the numbers of indices i with 0 <= i < len(moves) such that moves[i] = 85 ('U'), moves[i] = 68 ('D'), moves[i] = 76 ('L'), and moves[i] = 82 ('R'), respectively. The function does not fail: there exists a Boolean b such that judge_circle(moves) = Result.ok b. Moreover, b = true if and only if U = D and L = R; equivalently, b = true if and only if the final horizontal displacement R - L and the final vertical displacement U - D are both zero.
preconditions: moves is a nonempty byte slice with 1 <= len(moves) <= 20000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(moves), moves[i] is one of the ASCII bytes 85 ('U'), 68 ('D'), 76 ('L'), 82 ('R').
